programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Jaane Jigar
programme.desc: Two women look identical but hail from different backgrounds. They fall in love with Ravi and Vijay who are best friends. Misunderstandings arise when they believe they are in love with the same girl.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.desc: Beef, Crispy Squid, Polenta Cake. Jamie prepares high-speed Ginger Shakin' Beef with pak choi. Then, he makes crispy squid and smashed avocado, plus almond, orange and polenta cake. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Pork Burger, Prawns, Gnocchi, Cheesecake. Jamie Oliver cooks pork burger, taking fast food to the next level! Later, he serves up sticky mango prawns and frozen banoffee cheesecake. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Cheesy Does It. Ina gets cheesy in the kitchen! She prepares dishes including coconut cupcakes with cream cheese icing, roasted vegetable frittata and the ultimate grilled cheese. S7, Ep9

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Back To Brooklyn. Ina and Jeffrey relive delicious memories with a trip to Brooklyn. They feast on potato latkes and homemade applesauce, and make Clam, Chilli and Parsley Pizza. S7, Ep10

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Almost halfway through the Bake Off and the remaining bakers are facing pies and tarts. They are asked to bake a custard tart and a mini pear pie. S5, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Past halfway in their baking marathon and the remaining six bakers face three European cakes: a yeast-leavened cake, a Swedish princess torte and a dobos torte. S5, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Northumberland. James samples the delights of Northumberland, joined by Michelin-starred chef Kenny Atkinson. They learn how mead is made on Holy Island. S1, Ep13

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Isle of Man. James visits the Isle of Man during its famous TT warm-up week. He's joined by Michelin-starred chef and fellow petrolhead, Lisa Goodwin-Allen. S1, Ep14

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Meat Lover's Paradise. Guy Fieri takes a meat-crazed master class with master butchers. He checks out a pastrami-loving eatery serving burgers and cheesesteaks. S18, Ep2

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
